evidence: Carries Validation label and fundamentally restructures error reporting across src/validation.cpp, src/validation.h, and src/consensus/validation.h.
rationale: Separates fatal runtime and I/O failures from consensus and policy validation states in functions like ConnectBlock, FlushStateToDisk, and ActivateBestChain. This removes an architectural hazard where operational disk failures could be conflated with block invalidity and paves the way for #35570.
